details.facts:
The company provided contracts to workers, and the contracts were signed and approved by the legal authority; 
however, the contracts were in French. According to management, the contracts are explained to workers 
before being signed, and they are working on providing new contracts in the local language. / L’entreprise a 
remis des contrats aux travailleurs, et les contrats ont été signés et approuvés par l’autorité légale ; cependant,

d’être signés, et l’entreprise travaille à fournir de nouveaux contrats dans la langue locale.
EN: Ensure contracts are provided to workers in the local language.
FR: S’assurer que les contrats soient remis aux travailleurs dans la langue 
locale.
